summary: The author announces that a model's weights are now published on Hugging Face and runnable through several third-party inference frameworks, having been cleared under Meta's internal scaling safety framework for open release.

mechanisms.reason: The model is stated to run via on-device/edge runtimes MLX and executorch, in addition to server-side stacks.

practices.reason: Weights being published on Hugging Face means the model can now be self-hosted or fine-tuned rather than only accessed via API.
The model becoming runnable across ollama, LM Studio, vllm, sglang, together, fireworks, openrouter, llama.cpp, MLX and executorch creates concrete new deployment surfaces to evaluate and integrate.
practices.quote: running this week through ollama, LM Studio, vllm, sglang, together, fireworks, and openrouter, with llama.cpp, MLX, and executorch.

practices.reason: The post names an internal safety scaling framework used to clear the release but gives no transferable methodology detail.
practices.quote: evaluated under meta's advanced AI scaling framework and cleared for open-weight release.
